title: fix(client): migrate to Tailwind v4 (repairs the 12 gates failing on PR #310)
intent: PR #310 bumps tailwindcss 3.4.19 -> 4.3.3 as a lockfile-only Dependabot change and fails 12 gates. Tailwind v4 moved its PostCSS plugin out of the tailwindcss package into @tailwindcss/postcss, so postcss.config.js's `tailwindcss: {}` entry throws 'trying to use tailwindcss directly as a PostCSS plugin' at CSS transform time. This carries the migration the version bump needs. Note the governance question recorded below: tailwindcss is absent from the dependabot ignore list while every other client major is gated there, so closing #310 and adding the ignore is a legitimate alternative to landing this.
behavior_change: Build-pipeline migration. Rendered output is intended to be equivalent: the emitted CSS was verified to still contain the utilities in use, and the @apply rules were verified to expand with Vue scoping intact.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds @tailwindcss/postcss@4.3.3 and points postcss.config.js at it (autoprefixer retained for the project's own hand-written CSS; v4 prefixes its own output internally). Replaces the three @tailwind directives in src/styles/main.css with a single @import "tailwindcss". Deletes tailwind.config.js. Adds @reference "tailwindcss" to the five Vue SFC <style> blocks that use @apply.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Each edit addresses a distinct v4 breaking change, and omitting any one still fails. The postcss plugin move is the crash. The @tailwind -> @import change is the v4 entrypoint form. The @reference additions are required because v4 compiles each style block in isolation with no implicit theme access, so @apply cannot resolve without them - a fix limited to postcss.config.js and main.css would clear the reported error and then break on those five components. tailwind.config.js is deleted rather than migrated to a @theme block because its entire theme.extend.colors surface is unused (0 usages, measured).

commands_run: USAGE MEASUREMENT, parsing only the contents of class/:class/className attributes rather than raw file text: custom theme utilities (bg-/text-/border- etc. of primary|success|warning|danger|risk|surface|border) = 0 usages across 0 files; stock Tailwind utilities = 6923 usages across 294 files. Tailwind is heavily used; its custom theme is entirely dead config. A naive repo-wide grep returns ~93 apparent hits which are ALL substrings inside CSS custom properties such as var(--color-text-primary) - measuring inside class attributes is what makes the answer trustworthy

@apply INVENTORY: 8 real CSS @apply directives across 5 files, all inside Vue SFC <style> blocks, 0 in standalone .css. A first regex using the character class [. -] (a reversed range) reported 0 and was wrong; a second method found them. After patching, asserted the invariant directly - zero style blocks contain @apply without @reference
npm ci -> exit 0. This is the command docker/client/Dockerfile and packages/client/Dockerfile run, so it covers the 4 container gates and the Railway gate, not just the dev path
npm run build -> exit 0, 931K of CSS emitted

OUTPUT CONTENT CHECK (the check that actually decides this): grepped the emitted bundles for utilities known to be in use - .flex, .rounded, .items-center, .bg-white, .w-full, .text-gray-500 - ALL PRESENT. A green build over an empty stylesheet would have passed every gate and shipped an unstyled app across 6923 utility usages

@apply EXPANSION CHECK: emitted CSS contains input[type=range][data-v-b27b8c48]{height:calc(var(--spacing,.25rem) * 2);cursor:pointer;appearance:none;border-radius:...} under a /*! tailwindcss v4.3.3 */ banner, confirming v4 expanded the directives with Vue scoping intact. Zero raw @apply leaked into the bundle
npm test -> 42 files passed / 1 skipped, 765 tests passed, 0 test failures. Identical to the pristine-main baseline, so this migration introduces no test regressions

PRE-EXISTING FAILURE, NOT CAUSED HERE: src/testing/__tests__/nodeEngineFloor.spec.ts fails locally with SyntaxError. Proven unrelated by control - with ALL changes stashed on a pristine tree it fails identically. It is green in CI because CI is Linux; it does not run on Windows. The file is correct LF per .gitattributes with no BOM but carries 18 non-ASCII bytes, and the reported position (line 4 byte 31) is ordinary ASCII, so the location is misattributed. Landed via #307; flagged, not touched

ROOT-CAUSE COVERAGE: the 12 failing gates on #310 are 7 distinct gates duplicated across push/pull_request runs, every one downstream of the single client-build failure - lint-build (vite build), Containers/build-and-test/proxy-parity/proxy-adaptive (docker/client/Dockerfile npm ci + npm run build), Railway client (packages/client/Dockerfile), and Core CI Summary (aggregator). No API or Python gate fails, and SG_SPEC_TOKEN is present in the container jobs, confirming the old Dependabot-secret pattern is resolved and this is a clean single-cause failure

CSS SELECTOR-SET DIFF v3 vs v4 - the check that caught the only real regression. Built the tree twice (tailwindcss 3.4.19 then 4.3.3) and extracted every class selector from all 85 emitted CSS bundles: v3 = 4620 selectors / 767,612 bytes; v4 = 4751 / 787,117. Exactly ONE selector existed in v3 and not v4: .bg-opacity-50, which Tailwind v4 REMOVED in favour of slash syntax. It was live in 3 modal backdrops (RosettePatternLibraryEnhanced.vue:27, RiskActionsModal.vue:5, RunDetailModal.vue:5, all `bg-black bg-opacity-50`), so under v4 those overlays would have rendered FULLY OPAQUE BLACK. That regression passes the build, all 765 tests, and spot-checks for individual utilities - only a full selector diff surfaces it. Replaced with bg-black/50 and confirmed `.bg-black\/50` is emitted in index-BozNL13s.css. Swept for the other removed *-opacity-* variants: none remain. CAVEAT on method: the extraction regex collapses escaped-slash selectors (.bg-black\/50 -> bg-black), so it under-counts slash-opacity utilities identically on both sides and is blind to that class; the /50 rule was therefore confirmed by direct grep, not by the set comparison. A fully symmetric diff would require rebuilding v3 against the fixed source, which was not done - the single discrepancy is explained and independently verified instead
npm test after the opacity fix -> 42 files passed / 1 skipped, 765 passed, 0 test failures; unchanged from the pristine-main baseline

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Build-pipeline migration touching CSS generation for the whole client, hence medium risk on the three pipeline files. Mitigated by checking output content rather than exit codes: the emitted bundles were verified to contain the utilities in use and the expanded @apply rules, because the dangerous failure mode here is a silent no-op that passes every gate and ships an unstyled app. GOVERNANCE, unresolved and deliberately not decided here: tailwindcss is absent from .github/dependabot.yml's ignore list while vite, vitest, @vitejs/plugin-vue, vue-router, pinia, typescript>=7, eslint and @typescript-eslint/* are all gated there as Tranche C majors. That omission is why #310 was generated. The established precedent for this class (#280, #282, #283, #288) is to CLOSE the Dependabot PR and add the ignore, landing the migration as a deliberate human PR. This branch is that deliberate migration; whether it lands, and whether tailwindcss joins the ignore list either way, is an owner decision.
